title: Heart Blossom Dream
description: A woman with long flowing brown hair stands in the lower right, wearing a dress made of pink and red hearts. She reaches upward with both hands as a swirling stream of hearts, pink butterflies, and yellow flowers rises from her palms toward the sky. The background features a deep blue and purple vortex containing floating classical columns and two ornate picture frames with yellow flowers inside.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a woman with long flowing hair wearing a dress composed of overlapping pink and red hearts. She stands with hands raised, releasing a swirling vortex of red and pink hearts, butterflies, and yellow blossoms that spiral upward into a deep blue and purple sky. Classical white columns and two decorative picture frames containing yellow flowers float among clouds in the background. Dramatic swirling composition with floating petals and romantic atmosphere.
